utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Registrar, could you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Registrar. Today is Monday, the 22nd of March, 2010. I would like to greet all the accused in the courtroom as well as the counsels and the members of the OTP. First of all, I would like to give the floor to the Registrar who has a few IC numbers to give us.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Some parties have submitted list of documents to be tendered through Witness Zdenko Andabak. The list submitted by 5D shall be given Exhibit IC01208; the list submitted by 2D shall be given Exhibit IC01209; the list submitted by 3D shall be given Exhibit IC01210; and the list submitted by 4D shall be given Exhibit IC01211; the list submitted by the OTP, finally, shall be given Exhibit IC01212. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Registrar. We're going to move to closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 23rd day of March, 2010, at 9.00 a.m. 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: [The Accused Praljak and Pusic not present]
--- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.00 p.m.,
